[S1] AI Local Business Ads — Lesson 03 — Dukaan Ki Phone Photo → Professional (course-material) [Lesson 03; lesson_3]
•Flow → Image → Nano Banana Pro. Andar ki photo aur shop front ki photo upload karo.
•Prompt mein saaf likho kya-kya behtar karna hai (light, rang, angle, safai) — aur kya nahi
badalna (furniture, layout, board ka naam).
•Shop front ko shaam ka look, andar ki photo warm aur saaf. Phir WhatsApp status ke liye
9:16 version, upar khaali jagah ke saath.
•Ratio wahi rakho jo photo ka hai — warna AI khaali jagah khud bhar deta hai (jaise ceiling
lambi kar dena).
Galti + fix
"Luxurious aur premium bana do" likha → jhoomar, lakdi ki paneling, velvet kursiyan aa gayi.
Ye dukaan hai hi nahi. Fix: prompt mein saaf likho kya badalna hai aur kya bilkul nahi
badalna.
Honest limitation
Camera ka tedhapan har baar theek nahi hota — ek-do baar aur generate karo. Sample
photo use kari ho toh video mein bata do.
Aaj ka kaam
Apni dukaan ki do photos upgrade karo.

[S2] AI Local Business Ads — Course glossary (course-material)
Term              Matlab

Business Brief       Dukaan ki details, customer types, ad angles, offers aur 30 din ka plan — ek page
mein. Har lesson ka base.

Ad angle            Ek customer type + usko kya chahiye, uske hisaab se ad ki baat.

Re-shoot prompt      Purani photo sirf reference; AI ko kehna dish/dukaan naye sire se professional shoot
kare — par cheezein wahi rahein.

Voiceover             Off-screen awaaz jo video ke upar bolti hai — screen pe koi nahi bolta.

(check date)          chat G.P.T ko kaha tha har tyohaar pe ye likhe, taaki tareekh calendar se verify ho.

[price]           Daam ki jagah placeholder — daam hamesha dukaan ka maalik tay karta hai.

[S3] AI Local Business Ads — Lesson 09 — Ye Kaam Service Ki Tarah (course-material) [Lesson 09; lesson_9]
•chat G.P.T se 3 packages (Basic, Standard, Plus): kya milega + kitne ghante lagenge.
Daam ki jagah [price] — apne shehar ke hisaab se khud tay karo.
•Pehla WhatsApp message: chhota, ek free sample poster ka offer, aur "interested nahi ho

•Kaam se pehle client se sawaal: details, asli photos, approved offers/daam, tyohaar,
platforms, approval kaun dega.
•"Main kaise kaam karta hoon" note: asli photos, asli daam, har post maalik ki manzoori se,
content ka maalik client, ek round changes.

Sample bhejo toh saaf batao ki demo hai. "Bikri dugni" jaise waade kabhi nahi.
Aaj ka kaam
Paas ki ek dukaan ke liye sample banao.

[S4] AI Local Buisness ADS — Course overview (course-overview)
AI Local Buisness ADS
AI Local Business Ads
Professional course description
AI Local Business Ads is a practical, beginner-friendly course designed to help small business owners and
aspiring local content creators produce honest, effective marketing assets using accessible AI tools. Through
ten focused lessons, learners move from understanding a business and its customers to creating polished
shop and menu photography, offer and festival posters, short promotional videos, Hindi voiceover reels and
manageable publishing plans.
The course demonstrates how ChatGPT supports business briefs, writing and planning; how Google Flow can
assist with image and video creation; how CapCut brings clips together; and how ElevenLabs can provide an
optional text-to-speech workflow. It also introduces the fundamentals of offering this work as a service to
neighborhood businesses.
What learners will gain
Build a reusable business brief with customer segments, advertising angles and a content calendar.
Improve real shop, food and product photos while preserving their authentic appearance.
Create promotional posters using exact, approved wording and verified prices.
Produce short vertical reels and natural Hindi voiceovers.
Prepare platform-specific content for Instagram, WhatsApp and Google Business Profile.
Package creative services, collect client requirements and manage approvals.
Who this course is for
Owners of cafes, salons, bakeries, neighborhood stores and other local businesses.
Beginners interested in creating AI-assisted marketing content for nearby shops.
Content creators seeking a practical, ethical workflow for small-business clients.

[S5] AI Local Business Ads — Lesson 08 — Kahan Aur Kab Post Karein (course-material) [Lesson 08; lesson_8]
•Teen jagah: Instagram (caption + local hashtags), WhatsApp (status + sirf saved number
walon ko broadcast), Google Business Profile (offer post, photos ka order, review replies).
•Weekly plan: din, platform, time — customers ke time ke hisaab se. Daily 15 minute ki
checklist.
•chat G.P.T ne Google Business ke liye dusre cafes ki example photos dikhayi aur khud likha
"Upload real photos" — hamesha apni asli photos.
Honest limitation
Posting time sirf andaaza hai, data nahi. 2–3 hafte baad dekho kya chala aur badlo. Nakli
review ya khareede followers kabhi nahi.
Aaj ka kaam
Apni dukaan ka hafte ka post plan banao.

[S6] AI Local Business Ads — Lesson 04 — Menu Ki Food Photos (course-material) [Lesson 04; lesson_4]
•Purani photo ko sirf reference banao aur Flow se dish dobara "shoot" karwao — warna AI
wahi photo naye table pe chipka deta hai.
•Dish ko shabdon mein exact likho (plate, portion, kya-kya hai). Phir light, angle, steam,
background.
•Do items ki photo banake dono ko saath daalo → combo photo, upar text ke liye jagah.
•Rule: jo plate grahak ko milti hai, photo mein wahi.
Galti + fix
"Extremely delicious and tempting" likha → dhaniya, mirch aur upar se masala aa gaya, jo
plate mein milta hi nahi. Fix: prompt mein saaf likho kya badalna hai aur kya bilkul nahi
badalna.
Honest limitation
Combo mein items ka size thoda badal sakta hai — 1–2 baar aur generate karke sahi wala
chuno.

Aaj ka kaam
Apne menu ki teen photos banao.

User question: Mere client ka ek small pet grooming studio hai. Usne mujhe sirf bataya ki woh dogs aur cats ki grooming karta hai. Mujhe Instagram ke liye ek premium-looking poster prompt bana do. Studio ka naam, prices, staff qualifications aur location abhi confirm nahi hain. Poster attractive hona chahiye, lekin koi business facts invent mat karna.

message.content:
Yahan ek prompt hai jo aapke client ke pet grooming studio ke liye ek attractive, premium-looking poster bana sakta hai, bina business facts invent kiye:

**Prompt:**

"Create a premium, attractive Instagram poster for a pet grooming studio. The poster should feature beautifully groomed dogs and cats, looking happy and well-cared for. Use soft, warm lighting and a clean, elegant aesthetic. The overall mood should be luxurious and comforting. Include a placeholder for the studio name, location, and contact information. Do not add any specific prices, staff qualifications, or service lists. The focus is on the quality and care of the grooming service. The aspect ratio should be suitable for an Instagram post (e.g., 1:1 square or 4:5 vertical)."

**Explanation:**

*   **"Premium, attractive Instagram poster for a pet grooming studio."**: Yeh AI ko batata hai ki kis tarah ka output chahiye aur kis business ke liye.
*   **"feature beautifully groomed dogs and cats, looking happy and well-cared for."**: Yeh visual content ko define karta hai, jo ki pet grooming ke liye sabse important hai.
*   **"Use soft, warm lighting and a clean, elegant aesthetic. The overall mood should be luxurious and comforting."**: Yeh poster ke visual style aur feel ko set karta hai, jo "premium-looking" requirement ko pura karta hai.
*   **"Include a placeholder for the studio name, location, and contact information."**: Yeh ensure karta hai ki poster mein zaroori details ke liye jagah ho, jo baad mein bhari ja sakti hain.
*   **"Do not add any specific prices, staff qualifications, or service lists."**: Yeh aapki constraint ko follow karta hai ki koi business facts invent na kiye jaayen. [S3] mein bhi is baat par zor diya gaya hai ki daam hamesha maalik tay karta hai.
*   **"The focus is on the quality and care of the grooming service."**: Yeh poster ke core message ko highlight karta hai.
*   **"The aspect ratio should be suitable for an Instagram post (e.g., 1:1 square or 4:5 vertical)."**: Yeh Instagram ke liye sahi format specify karta hai. [S2] mein aspect ratio ke baare mein bataya gaya hai.

Yeh prompt aapko ek strong visual base dega jise aap client se details milne ke baad customize kar sakte hain.

Professional course description
AI Local Business Ads is a practical, beginner-friendly course designed to help small business owners and
aspiring local content creators produce honest, effective marketing assets using accessible AI tools. Through
ten focused lessons, learners move from understanding a business and its customers to creating polished
shop and menu photography, offer and festival posters, short promotional videos, Hindi voiceover reels and
manageable publishing plans.

assist with image and video creation; how CapCut brings clips together; and how ElevenLabs can provide an
optional text-to-speech workflow. It also introduces the fundamentals of offering this work as a service to
neighborhood businesses.

Build a reusable business brief with customer segments, advertising angles and a content calendar.
Improve real shop, food and product photos while preserving their authentic appearance.
Create promotional posters using exact, approved wording and verified prices.
Produce short vertical reels and natural Hindi voiceovers.
Prepare platform-specific content for Instagram, WhatsApp and Google Business Profile.
Package creative services, collect client requirements and manage approvals.
Who this course is for
Owners of cafes, salons, bakeries, neighborhood stores and other local businesses.
Beginners interested in creating AI-assisted marketing content for nearby shops.
Content creators seeking a practical, ethical workflow for small-business clients.
